description: Frozen Aralia accuracy set (43 models, exact top-event probabilities) plus generic-pwr-model (95 event-tree-group XMLs, compile/size/throughput only). synthetic-models is excluded (no license).
versioning: A dataset version never changes once used. Schema or contents changes are a new version (v2, …). The harness, PR gate (#122) and published history (#123) pin a dataset id.

models.perf_reason: Small model; baseline for launch, JIT, and host overhead. Kernel time is ~9–13 ms at 1e8, so fixed costs are visible.
Sampler-dominated: on V100S at 1e8 trials, basic_event is ~89% of GPU kernel time (37.6 of 42.1 ms, PR #91). Gate kernels are a small tail.

models.notes: n·p = 0.00218 at the 100663296 trial cap (fzb --trials 1e8); 1000 hits would need n ≈ 4.61e+13, which is outside the accuracy time budget.

accuracy.reason: p_ref 2.16942e-11 is below the 2^-32 Bernoulli threshold (~2.33e-10, #17); the sampler represents those events as 0; expected hits n·p_ref = 0.00218 at the budgeted 100663296 trials (far below 16; 1000 hits would need n ≈ 4.61e+13). Rare-event methods are #6 / #17 / #91, not a larger CI budget

models.perf_reason: 1,567 basic events (largest Aralia sampler). #20: the fused BE tile does not fit in shared memory and falls back to per-work-group global scratch.
models.notes: Accuracy n is 100663296 (96·2^20, same as fzb --trials 1e8) so n·p ≈ 1001. CPU accuracy budget is 180s (3× the 60s default) because the sampler walks 1,567 events. fzb inspect --exact refuses 1,567 SAMPLE events (cap 30); scram-cli --bdd/--zbdd OOMs on this model.
